slides.sub: Why most astrology tools skip the hard computation.

slides.body: Many tools check one or two placements, such as Sun sign or Moon sign, and attach a stock paragraph. That is why advice contradicts itself.

points: Varga (divisional charts) like D-9 and D-10

slides.body: Each layer has its own rules and they can disagree. Doing this by hand for every chart is slow and error-prone. Shadbala (six-fold planetary strength) adds more calculation.
AI is good at tedious, rule-based computation at scale. It computes every layer consistently, so the astrologer can focus on judgement.
It should not replace the astrologer's judgement or hide conflicts. A good reading states where layers disagree rather than averaging them away.
Ask any tool: which layers did you check, and what happens when they conflict? A clear answer is the sign of a real reading.
